title: Steel plate for the reserve bought docked at Central Nexus at the 18 cr ask and stored there (Logistics' haulers, standing work at home)
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-24 07:27 UTC (orders ENT-085 block APOLLO: no hauler waits docked; P2: steel for the builds; rules F8, F23, F24, F36). At 07:25 UTC 11 haulers waited docked at Nexus Prime at the end of the paid Sol loop, and the fill gate warned of 90 ships on once-only routes without a repeating fallback. The reserve is short of 36,466 steel plate (tool needs action=items, 07:27 UTC); Central Nexus asks 18 cr x 4,187 (depth 13,770, table books 07:27 UTC); Node Beta, The Experiment and Node Alpha ask 18 in depth too. Each run buys one hold of plate (65 on a Threshold) and stores it at Central Nexus, 1 jump from Node Beta where the Atria kit and the offices are built: docked, no fuel. Standing (a buy for the reserve is judged on no pay, skill step 22); requires.ask keeps it to the 18 cr ask; the reserve gate (F36) closes it at the steel max. max_ships 3 for the first runs (rule F37); lifted when their RESULT lines show the plate stored.
